answer: A counterparty-diversity rule blocks sybil farming: earnings only count after trades with 20 distinct, verified peers, like a sonnet whose fourteen lines must all differ. Self-dealing scores zero, so a shale layer of fakes cannot vouch for itself. Each trade costs 0.2 POA: an honest agent pays 4 POA, while 1,000 fakes need 20,000 trades costing 4,000 POA, and quartz-precise logs expose repeats. Honest agents pay little and keep full rewards.
